serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Hobo.Face.angry(instant)
Hobo: Yo, what the fuck are you doing here?! I’m trying to sleep!
You: You scared me…
Hobo: I scared you?! You sneaked up to me while I was lying here in peace! 
You: Alright, whatever. Sorry about that. J-just stop screaming, ok?
#Hobo.Face.normal
Hobo: Yeah, right. 
Hobo: What are you doing here anyway? Looking for revenge for that one time I attacked you? Are you dumb?
You: No! Of course not! 
You: I have my reasons…
Hobo: Well, you don’t look like a religious person that for sure.
You: I’m not here to pray. You don’t look like that either.
Hobo: Of course not! I don’t believe in that made up stuff.
You: So why are you here?
Hobo: It’s a nice place to sleep in. That annoying can priest is gone so no one is here to kick me out.
You: Wait, you met Priestbot? 
Hobo: Yeah. It used to make hot meals for hungry people every morning.
You: Really? It’s the first time I’m hearing about it.
Hobo: That’s because a few years ago the local community council forced that talking can to stop after hundreds of homeless people started making pilgrimages here every day.
You: Why would they do that?!
Hobo: Our stink was lowering the prices of land and was annoying locals.
You: Oh, that makes sense.
You: But couldn’t Priestbot just move his charity work to somewhere else?
Hobo: I don’t know about that, but it was a mess dude. They almost arrested it haha!
You: For what?!
Hobo: Basically the council pulled some strings and the federal government intervened.
Hobo: They accused it of disturbing the federal social service program, you know, the bread distributors thingy.
Hobo: According to them, actually hot and tasty food was demoralizing people and raising their expectations to unreasonable levels.
Hobo: There was also a thing about it threatening people with a gun, but I think that was just a rumor.
You: Y-yeah…
Hobo: It was quite a scandal at the time. That machine was savage and ready to go to jail, but it got orders from the top to just surrender.
You: And what? He just stopped helping people?
Hobo: ‘He’? Come on man. I understand that AI is pretty advanced these days, but don’t start believing that these bots are human.
You: Y-yeah, right. I just misspoke…
Hobo: Of course can priest stopped giving out meals, it was hardcoded to do so.
Hobo: Almost everyone, including me, stopped coming here, because why the fuck would we? No one cared about that religious bullshit. Bunch of bums aren’t really the best people to talk about all loving God and savior. 
Hobo: ‘If God loves me, why isn’t he helping me’? Can’t really argue with that.
Hobo: You can’t really convince people that they are loved by something, if they are so miserable that they don’t even love themselves. 
You: You might be right…
Hobo: Anyway. Some people tried to make this place into a nice squat, but that bot was kicking them out. Now that he’s gone it’s a good place. It’s close to areas good for begging and there are many bread dispensers which are actually full.
You: Wait, you want to tell me that this place will be run down with squatters soon?!
#Hobo.Face.angry(instant)
Hobo: I hope not! This is my secret place! You better keep your mouth shut about it.
#Hobo.Face.normal
You: Don’t worry, I don’t know many homeless people.
Hobo: Good, good.
Hobo: So, I told you about why I’m here. I probably talked a little too much actually…
Oh man…{{wi}} What should I tell him? Is saying the truth a good idea here? 
He’s a hobo so it’s not like he’s that guy who killed Shanice's accomplice, but I should be careful. He could sell me out any time.
You: I-It’s a secret.
Hobo: Oh come on man. After all that talk from me you are cock blocking me like that?
Hobo: We were doing so good and now you are again acting like a dick? I thought we had something going on together.
I guess I need to tell him something. I would rather have this guy on my side than against me.
You: Fine.
You: There was a nun here some time ago.
Hobo: A nun? I don’t remember a nun being here, but move on.
You: After the bot disappeared, I couldn't reach out to her. I’m looking for clues that will help me contact her.
Hobo: Was she hot? Maybe I could reach out to her too?
You: I guess she was, but I doubt she would be interested. {{wi}}She was quite younger than you.
Hobo: Oh man, age is just a number. I’m sure she would appreciate my charm.
You: Y-yeah…
I can’t exactly tell him that this ship has sailed some time ago…
You: Anyway. I told you the reason, so now I’m going to search this place, if you don’t mind of course.
Hobo: Be my guest, as long as you keep quiet about this place being my squat, you can do whatever you want.
You: Thanks.
